maddeler.e: تَرْبَوِيّ • (tarbawiyy) (feminine تَرْبَوِيَّة (tarbawiyya), masculine plural تَرْبَوِيُّون (tarbawiyyūn), feminine plural تَرْبَوِيَّات (tarbawiyyāt))
maddeler.t: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of تَرْبِيَة (tarbiya, “education”) + ـَوـ (-aw-) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
s: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of تَرْبِيَة (tarbiya, “education”) + ـَوـ (-aw-) + ـِيّ (-iyy)
